diagnosis: The reconciliation handler accepts an arbitrary account_uuid as a query parameter and exports unsettled ledger transactions without verifying that the requesting corporate entity or financial analyst has administrative jurisdiction over that account, leaking transaction journals across banking accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /reconciliation/ledgers/transactions?account_uuid=b4e9e03d-8842-416a-b28e-5b1239841234 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.treasury.corp
Authorization: Bearer <analyst_token>
corrected_code:
from uuid import UUID
from litestar import get, Request
from litestar.params import Parameter
from litestar.di import Provide
from litestar.exceptions import NotAuthorizedException

@get("/reconciliation/ledgers/transactions")
async def export_ledger_transactions(
    request: Request,
    account_uuid: UUID = Parameter(query="account_uuid"),
    recon_service: ReconciliationService = Provide(get_recon_service)
) -> list[TransactionRecord]:
    if account_uuid not in request.user.permitted_account_ids and not request.user.is_treasury_admin:
        raise NotAuthorizedException(detail="Forbidden: access to specified corporate ledger denied")
    return await recon_service.get_unsettled_entries(account_uuid)
